# Markup that is not a citation

A markdown link such as [12](http://x) is not a citation, nor is a
reference label like [7]: http://example.com/label.

```text
Code that prints [1] is not prose.
```

The only real citation in this draft is the second paper [2].

## Sources

[2] https://example.org/paper/two?section=results — Paper two
